Team Leadership &amp; Operations:

Department/Unit: Finance
Reports to: Finance Manager
Direct Reports: N/A

Job Summary


	To provide support in bookkeeping, capturing of accounting transactions, bank reconciliation and reporting on financial transactions.
	Prepares records for remittance of statutory deductions such as: Value Added Tax (VAT), Withholding Tax (WHT), Capital Gain Tax and staff related statutory payments i.e. PAYE, Pension, NHF, etc.

	Relates effectively with the organisation&rsquo;s financial service providers.

	Performs other duties that may be assigned by the Accountant.

	Minimum of First Degree in Finance/ Accounting/ Business Administration/ Economics or any related discipline is required.

	Drive user acquisition, revenue, and adoption of our products through the execution a comprehensive growth strategy
	Draft and pitch our products to prospective organizations.
	Setting goals and developing plans for business and revenue growth.
	Market penetration, drive, and management of existing / potential users/agents.
	Foster and develop relationships with customers/clients.
	Planning regional/territory Sales Strategy, Consistent Target Delivery and Achievements.
	Development of the Team to meet & exceed Business metrics in the regions.
	Resolving critical sales/operational issue(s) that are beyond Business development officer.
	Work closely with the head of Growth to identify, prioritize, and execute growth opportunities.
	Continuous set up of new user acquisition campaigns and activations at cluster/market locations.
	Responsible for coordinating the activities and performance of Brand Ambassadors.
	Analyze user data and customer feedback to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for growth.
	Create and manage a growth dashboard to track key metrics and communicate progress to the leadership team.
	Stay up to date with the latest growth tactics and best practices in the industry.
	Develop and execute strategies to scale the company’s product by gaining adequate market share and industry leadership.

	Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
	Core strength and verifiable experience in scaling startups
	Strong analytical skills and experience using data to drive decision-making.
	Strong project management and team management skills.
	Experience with A/B testing and experimentation.
	Strong understanding of customer acquisition and retention strategies.
	Experience in the Fintech industry is a plus.
	Strong interpersonal and communication skills.


Professional Qualifications:


	Relevant professional certifications.
	At least 5+ years of experience working in a Growth and Strategy capacity delivering success in a Payment Solutions firm, top FINTECH, and financial institutions.
	Must have experience spearheading Growth Marketing for a Digital Payment Product or Application
	Good analytical skills.
	Proficient in Microsoft tools.


Skills & Competencies:

	Analytical thinking – Mastery
	Presentation Skills - Mastery
	Interpersonal skills - Mastery
	Communication – Mastery
	Business Skill - Mastery
	Functional Technical Leadership – Mastery
	Credibility - Mastery
	Adaptability- Skill

	Self-Motivation - Mastery

				A good understanding of what is involved in an area of expertise and its relevance to the business.
